classification: Review-driven replication authored after internal cross-track review; not independent external review
repair: Embed discriminant constants into the prime subfield: f.mul(27%f.p,b^2), with 4%f.p for consistency. In packed F17², integer27 otherwise denotes10+u.
regression: A=14,B=2 over F17² has true discriminant0; the original gate accepts it, the corrected driver must reject it

unchanged_fixture_grid.registered_arms: specified rational2-torsion; same seeded sampler/predicate r>=p and even cofactor; cofactor projected x-in-Fp base; generic two-sum table; same known-answer target and r-adding rho

execution: Run the original native unit controls plus the singular regression. Execute exactly the Fp2 panel of24 fixtures in a fresh directory; original prime m4 arms are not rerun or replaced.
cohort_check: Compare p,seed,a,b,nonresidue,order,r,cofactor,generator,target,torsion,curve_draws against the original24 records. Preserve and report every identity change/rejection; never substitute the corrected cohort into original denominators.
candidate_trace: Record every new sampler draw's field/seed/curve identity, acceptance and rejection reason. Logging adds no field/group operations.
verification: Use verify_v2 with pinned new result SHA256, exact target/hit coverage, Jacobian replay, corrected discriminants, point counts and projected-base membership
claim_limits: Same generic table diagnostic as original; no Gaudry oracle, Qcurve/GLS,2LP, full IC extraction, timing speedup or FourQ extrapolation
